newsitem.title: GERMANY: German industry business sentiment up in May-Ifo.
newsitem.headline: German industry business sentiment up in May-Ifo.

text.p: Business sentiment for German industry improved in May, with both west and east German firms feeling more optimistic about the future than in April, the Ifo economic research institute said on Wednesday.

But in the construction sector, sentiment remained equally negative in June as in May. West German firms were expecting more job losses, while in the east, an accelaration in the sector's job shedding rate was expected, Ifo said.

Companies surveyed by Ifo in west Germany said, however, that the competition environment had improved last month, with many expecting a growth in output. In the east, Ifo said industry was expecting a rise in exports, although they said job losses would continue.

In the retail sector, German companies continued to describe the situation as "unsatisfactory" despite a slight improvement in business conditions, Ifo said, since sales in the sector had slipped compared with year-ago levels.
With sales falling sharply and significant stockpile problems, stores in east Germany said they were very unhappy with buesiness conditions, the institute added.
Wholesalers also described conditions in their sector as unfavourable.
